moduleTitle: Travel and tourism, including places of interest

questions.examTip: Answer using information from the passage only; quoting the relevant French phrase alongside your English answer can help you check you haven't missed detail.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Millions of tourists from around the world ("des millions de touristes du monde entier").
2. The Eiffel Tower and the Louvre museum (accept Notre-Dame cathedral too) ("la Tour Eiffel, le musée du Louvre").
3. By metro, because it is fast and not expensive ("en métro parce que c'est rapide et pas cher").
4. Discover lesser-known areas, to avoid crowds and have a more authentic experience ("éviter la foule et vivre une expérience plus authentique").
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the passage and answer in English:

"Paris attire chaque année des millions de touristes du monde entier. Parmi les endroits les plus visités, on trouve la Tour Eiffel, le musée du Louvre et la cathédrale Notre-Dame. Beaucoup de visiteurs se déplacent en métro parce que c'est rapide et pas cher. L'office de tourisme recommande aussi de découvrir les petits quartiers moins connus pour éviter la foule et vivre une expérience plus authentique."

1. How many tourists does Paris attract each year, roughly?
2. Name two of the most visited places mentioned.
3. How do many visitors get around, and why?
4. What does the tourist office also recommend, and why?

questions.examTip: Translate the full meaning of each sentence into natural English rather than word-for-word; check tenses (perfect/present) carry across accurately.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Last summer, I went on holiday to France.
2. We booked a hotel near the beach.
3. The weather was nice during the whole stay.
4. I would like to visit Italy next year.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. L'été dernier, je suis allé(e) en vacances en France.
2. Nous avons réservé un hôtel près de la plage.
3. Il faisait beau pendant tout le séjour.
4. J'aimerais visiter l'Italie l'année prochaine.

Read and answer in English: « L'été dernier, je suis allé au bord de la mer en train. Nous avons visité un vieux château près de notre hôtel. L'année prochaine, je voudrais découvrir une grande ville française. »
1. Give one present detail.
2. What happened in the past?
3. What will or should happen later?
4. Give a reason or opinion.
questions.modelAnswer: Last summer, I went to the seaside by train. We visited an old castle near our hotel. Next year, I would like to discover a large French city.
questions.examTip: Use exact evidence, varied time frames and justified opinions; check negative wording and verb accuracy.

note.summary:
Travel and tourism, including places of interest
Key vocabulary
- la réservation
- une chambre
- un aller-retour
- un hébergement
- se situer

Revision focus
Practise present, past and future forms while discussing travel, tourism and places of interest. Build answers with justified opinions and precise examples.

Exam technique
- Spot time markers and negatives before answering.
- Use parce que/car to justify an opinion.
- Check adjective agreement, verb endings and whether the task asks for French or English.
